lede: MangoCloud is a personal project, still in development — a cloud storage built from scratch, as a naive idea put into practice.
lede_strong: Open to ideas, suggestions or help from any angle.

backend.name: Backend Services
backend.description: The engine underneath — storage, auth, and the API everything else talks to.

web.name: Web Client
web.description: The browser app you'd actually use day to day — upload, organize, share.

admin.name: Admin Dashboard
admin.description: A control room for the whole system — users, storage, and what's breaking.

invite_text: No idea is too small, no feedback too harsh. If you'd like to contribute or just ask something, reach out.
